name: Real-world illustration
rules: Identify the actual component before selecting a swatch.
Use recognizable real-world colors in a flat illustration style.
Use only the 24 reference tokens for colored fills and inner details; inner structural lines may remain black.
Render black outlines above all colored fills and inner strokes so color never covers the border.
Keep handle openings and other negative spaces transparent instead of treating every enclosed region as a solid surface.
At inner junctions, preserve continuous structural lines such as shelves and decorative bands; attached detail strokes must not interrupt them.
When a filled subject has an implied open silhouette, add a minimal black closure joining its natural endpoints. Preserve intentional holes and functional openings.
Creative color regions are allowed when they clarify the subject, such as liquid inside a flask. Keep them within the subject, use the theme palette, and preserve black outline visibility.
Repeat the same token on regions belonging to one logical part.
Use ACCENT_GRAY as the fallback for abstract or unknown components; neutral swatches are also valid for genuinely neutral materials.
Use fixed documented defaults for variable colors.
